notes: Completely redesigned the Wavely desktop interface to match the visual language of Wavely Website V2, with a refined Apple-inspired design system, improved typography, spacing, hierarchy, navigation, controls, cards, dialogs and responsive polish across Sounds, Packs, Presets and Settings; Redesigned the sign-in and account experience for a cleaner, more premium workflow; Removed the Community page and its navigation entry; Added reliable always-signed-in sessions with encrypted OS-protected token storage, atomic local persistence and automatic restoration before the main window opens; Preserved account and subscription state across restarts, rebuilds and upgrades; Fixed the duplicate open-folder handler that prevented the Electron app from launching; Fixed licensing-state initialization and startup availability; Added protection against EPIPE broken-output crashes when Wavely is launched without an attached terminal or a diagnostic stream closes; Updated the application, updater, licensing client, sidebar, release manifest, build output and Windows installer metadata consistently to version 1.0.6.
